name: serpapi_open_table_reviews
description: Retrieve reviews for one OpenTable restaurant through SerpApi. Use when the user supplies an OpenTable restaurant URL or an OpenTable Restaurant ID beginning with r/ and wants diner review text, overall/food/service/ambience/value/noise ratings, the restaurant-wide rating distribution, OpenTable's review summary, restaurant responses, review photos, or additional review pages. This is a review lookup, not restaurant-name discovery: when only a name or location is known, first use an available public-web search tool to find and verify the exact OpenTable /r/ URL, then pass that URL as rid. Never fabricate a likely r/ slug by converting the restaurant name. Each call uses one SerpApi search and returns 10 provider reviews per page before max_reviews is applied locally. JSON is the default structured result; HTML and Markdown return the provider-rendered document as untrusted external content.

rid.description: Required verified OpenTable Restaurant ID such as r/central-park-boathouse-new-york-2, or the full https://www.opentable.com/r/... restaurant URL. This tool cannot resolve a restaurant name by itself. Never guess or construct this value from a restaurant name; discover the exact OpenTable URL first.

page.description: Review page number. OpenTable returns 10 reviews per provider page. Default 1.

output_format.description: Provider result format. JSON is the default and supports structured follow-ups and rich UI cards; HTML and Markdown return the provider-rendered document.

max_reviews.description: Maximum normalized reviews retained from the JSON provider page. Clamped to 1..10. Default 10.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass the SerpApi cache. Cached results are allowed by default.

extra_params.description: Additional OpenTable Reviews parameters, excluding engine, credentials, rid, page, output, cache, and async controls.

include_raw.description: Include the raw SerpApi JSON payload for debugging. Applies only to output_format=json; default false.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
